data.name: Faaidah
data.gender_notes: Faaidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who guides, assists, and supports others in their spiritual journey and daily lives. Derived from the Arabic verb ‘fa’ada’ which means ‘to instruct, guide or help’. The name Faaidah carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faaidah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of guidance and support, leading the way to knowledge and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Faaidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faaidah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In Islamic tradition, Faaidah refers to the rewards and blessings that one receives from Allah for their good deeds and righteous actions. It also implies the idea of gaining something of value or benefit from one's efforts and hard work. Faaidah is considered a positive and desirable outcome in Islam, and it is often associated with moral and spiritual growth, as well as material prosperity. In modern times, the name Faaidah has become popular among Muslim parents, who hope to bestow upon their child the blessings and benefits of a successful and fulfilling life.
